tagline: Providing unparalleled guest service, connectivity, and schedules across North America, Latin America, Asia, and the Pacific
hero_kpi_rationale: Key measure of operational efficiency and capacity utilization, reflecting demand and growth strategy post-Hawaiian integration

kpis.name: Total Operating Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned by the company through its core business activities.
kpis.description: Total revenue increased by 3% on a pro forma basis, driven by the integration of Hawaiian Airlines and higher average price per mile (yield).

kpis.name: Pretax Income
kpis.explanation: Company's profit before payment of taxes.
kpis.description: Pretax income declined to $146 million in 2025 from $545 million in 2024, largely due to IT disruptions and a partial government shutdown.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline due to technological incidents and government shutdown

kpis.name: Load Factor
kpis.explanation: Percentage of seats occupied relative to total capacity.
kpis.description: Load factor decreased from 83.9% in 2024 to 82.9% in 2025, reflecting capacity growth outpacing traffic growth.

kpis.name: Revenue per Available Seat-Mile
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated for each available seat-mile.
kpis.description: RASM improved due to better pricing and the ramp-up of the Atmos Rewards loyalty program.
kpis.signal: Improved average pricing despite demand pressure

kpis.name: Cost per Available Seat-Mile (excluding fuel)
kpis.explanation: Operating cost excluding fuel per available seat-mile.
kpis.description: CASMex increased in 2025, affected by Hawaiian integration costs and operational disruptions.

kpis.name: Economic Fuel Cost
kpis.explanation: Average price paid per gallon of jet fuel.
kpis.description: Fuel costs decreased by 8%, benefiting profitability despite other pressures.

kpis.name: Available Capacity (ASMs)
kpis.explanation: Total number of seat-miles offered to passengers.
kpis.description: Capacity increased by 1.9%, in line with the controlled growth strategy post-integration.

kpis.name: Total Headcount (FTE)
kpis.description: Headcount increased with the integration of Hawaiian Airlines, reflecting group expansion.

kpis.name: Losses from Operational Disruptions
kpis.explanation: Amount lost due to technological incidents and strikes.
kpis.description: IT incidents (July and October, approximately $50 million) and a government shutdown (approximately $30 million) resulted in about $80 million in losses in 2025.

kpis.name: Launch of Atmos Rewards Loyalty Program
kpis.explanation: New program combining Mileage Plan and HawaiianMiles with a new premium credit card.
kpis.description: Launched in August 2025, the Atmos Rewards program boosted credit card acquisitions, member spending, and loyalty program revenues.
kpis.signal: Key transformation in customer experience and revenue

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity incident at Hawaiian Airlines in June 2025; limited impact but revealed systemic vulnerabilities

risks.title: Operational Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Major technology incidents in July and October 2025 causing approximately $80 million in losses

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Competitive market, pricing pressure, and margin compression

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: Government regulations affecting operations and costs

risks.title: Geopolitical
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical risks affecting operational stability and international routes

risks.title: Technology
risks.score_rationale: Critical dependence on IT systems confirmed by 2025 incidents; third-party vendor failures

risks.title: Human Resources
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing collective bargaining negotiations for multiple employee groups; risk of disruption

risks.title: Hawaiian Integration
risks.score_rationale: Complex integration process generating additional costs and operational complexity
